blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-driven 3D Gaussian editing commonly does not distinguish the editing reliability of rendered views, although different viewpoints provide supervision of substantially different quality. Views that clearly show the scene and match the edit instruction provide reliable guidance, while less informative views may weaken the edit when all views are treated equally. We present View Matters , a view-importance-aware framework that conducts editing around reliable keyframes. Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) identifies reliable views using geometric visibility, semantic distinctiveness, and edit relevance. Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) then propagates their editing signals asymmetrically to non-keyframes without noisy reverse influence, while Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) preserves this reliability preference during 3DGS optimization. Across 23 scene–prompt pairs, View Matters achieves the highest average CLIP text–image similarity of 0.2822 and directional similarity of 0.2564 among the evaluated methods, with a four-minute editing time. Additional adjacent-view analysis indicates that the fidelity-oriented editing process maintains cross-view coherence.
blocks.zh: 文本驱动的3D Gaussian编辑通常不会区分渲染观点的编辑可靠性,尽管不同的观点提供了实质上不同质量的监督. 清晰显示场景并匹配编辑指令的视图提供了可靠的指导,而信息较少的视图可能会在所有视图得到同等对待时削弱编辑. 我们提出“视图问题”,这是一个围绕可靠的关键框架进行编辑的具有视图重要性的框架。 关键框架重要性估计(KIE)利用几何可见度、语义特征和编辑相关性确定可靠的观点。 Keyframe-Guided edition(KGE)随后将它们的编辑信号不对称地传播到非键框,没有吵闹的反向影响,而重要性-智能优化(IAO)则在3DGS优化期间保持这种可靠性偏好. 在23场景中 - 瞬间对齐, View Matters实现最高的CLIP文本平均相似度为0.2822,在评价方法中方向相似度为0.2564,编辑时间为4分钟. 其他相邻视图分析显示,以忠诚为导向的编辑过程保持了交叉视图的一致性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-driven 3D editing modifies reconstructed scenes from natural-language instructions. Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable this task through differentiable rendering and pretrained image editors Haque et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024) . In particular, the explicit representation and efficient rendering of 3DGS make it well suited for iterative 3D editing Kerbl et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 文本驱动的3D编辑从自然语言指令中修改了重建的场景. 神经辐射场(NERFs)和3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)通过不同的渲染和预训图像编辑器Haque等人(2023年);Wang等人(2024年)使这项任务得以完成. 特别是,3DGS的明确表述和高效渲染使得它非常适合迭代3D编辑Kerbl等人(2023年).

blocks.en: Most text-driven 3DGS editing methods follow a render–edit–optimize pipeline: a scene is rendered from multiple viewpoints, the rendered images are edited by a pretrained 2D model, and the edited observations are used to optimize the 3D representation Wang et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2024) . A limitation of this paradigm is that editing supervision is not equally reliable across viewpoints. Informative views provide faithful editing signals, whereas ambiguous views may produce weak or inaccurate edits. Treating all views equally allows these unreliable signals to propagate into and accumulate during 3DGS optimization, reducing the fidelity of the edit.
blocks.zh: 大部分文字驱动的3DGS编辑方法遵循渲染–编辑–优化管道:一个场景从多个角度渲染,渲染的图像由预先训练的2D模型编辑,编辑的观测结果用于优化3D代表王等人(2024年);吴等人(2024年). 这种模式的一个局限性是,编辑监督在各种观点上并不同样可靠。 信息化观点提供忠实的编辑信号,而模棱两可的观点则可能产生弱或不准确的编辑. 平等对待所有视图可以让这些不可靠的信号在3DGS优化期间传播和积累,降低编辑的忠诚度.

blocks.en: Existing methods improve multi-view agreement through depth guidance, feature fusion, epipolar interaction, or shared attention Wu et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Lee et al. (2025) . Some methods already designate reference or key views for cross-view propagation. However, they do not explicitly determine which views should dominate the editing process. Symmetric interaction or uniform supervision, therefore, allows less reliable views to influence more reliable ones, making the final edit less faithful to the instruction. Consequently, the resulting views may agree with one another while expressing an edit that is weak or insufficiently faithful to the instruction.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过深度引导,特征聚变,极地互动,或共同关注吴等人(2024年),陈等人(2024年),李等人(2025年)等方法,改善多观点共识. 一些方法已经指定了交叉视图传播的参考或关键视图。 然而,它们没有明确确定哪些观点应主导编辑进程。 因此,对称互动或统一监督可以让不太可靠的观点影响更可靠的观点,使得最终编辑对指令的忠实度降低. 因此,由此产生的观点可能相互一致,同时表达一种软弱或对指令不够忠实的编辑方式。

blocks.en: Our key observation is that keyframe selection has a substantial impact on the final editing quality. This suggests that view-guided editing requires more than simply designating a set of anchors: the source–target roles should be assigned according to edit-specific reliability and maintained throughout both multi-view editing and subsequent 3D optimization. A view that provides clearer geometric, semantic, and edit-related evidence should provide guidance for a less informative view.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要看法是,关键框架的选择对最后编辑质量有重大影响。 这表明,以视图为指南的编辑需要的不仅仅是指定一组主播:源 - 目标角色应当根据特定编辑的可靠性来分配,并在整个多视图编辑和随后的3D优化过程中保持. 提供更清晰的几何、语义和编辑相关证据的观点,应为信息较少的观点提供指导。

blocks.en: Based on this observation, we propose View Matters . Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) determines which views provide reliable evidence for the requested edit. Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) transfers editing signals from these keyframes to non-keyframes without noisy reverse influence. Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) preserves the same reliability preference during 3DGS optimization, preventing reliable supervision from being diluted when edited views are projected back to the 3D representation. Shared keyframe guidance and local propagation maintain cross-view coherence throughout this process.
blocks.zh: 基于这一看法,我们提议 " 观点事项 " 。 关键框架重要性估计(KIE)确定哪些视图为请求的编辑提供可靠的证据。 Keyframe-Guided edition (KGE) 将这些 keyframes 的编辑信号转移到非 keyframes 而不产生噪音的反向影响. 重要性-意识优化(IAO)在3DGS优化期间保持了相同的可靠性偏好,防止在将编辑过的视图投射回3D表示时,将可靠的监督稀释. 共享的关键框架指导和地方宣传在整个过程中保持了交叉视野的一致性。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We formulate text-driven 3DGS editing as an unequal-view-reliability problem and propose KIE to identify reliable editing anchors using geometric, semantic, and edit-related cues. • We introduce KGE to propagate reliable editing signals from keyframes to non-keyframes without reverse contamination and IAO to preserve the same reliability prior during 3DGS optimization. • Across 23 scene-prompt pairs, View Matters achieves the best average CLIP text–image and directional similarities among the evaluated methods with a four-minute editing time. Ablations verify the contribution of all three modules, while adjacent-view analysis indicates that improved fidelity does not sacrifice cross-view coherence.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 2D Image Editing
blocks.zh: 2.1 2D 图像编辑

blocks.en: Pretrained diffusion models provide strong semantic priors for text-guided image editing. P2P Hertz et al. (2022) controls edits through cross-attention, while ControlNet Zhang et al. (2023) introduces additional structural conditions. InstructPix2Pix (IP2P) Brooks et al. (2023) performs instruction-based image editing without requiring a user-provided target image. We adopt a frozen IP2P editor as the editing backbone and reorganize its attention for reliability-guided multi-view interaction.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的传播模型为文本制导的图像编辑提供了强大的语义前缀. P2P Hertz等人(2022年)通过交叉注意控制编辑,而ControlNet Zhang等人(2023年)引入了额外的结构条件. 指令Pix2Pix(IP2P)Brooks等人(2023)执行基于指令的图像编辑,而不需要用户提供的目标图像. 我们采用冷冻的IP2P编辑器作为编辑主干线,并重组其注意力,用于可靠性引导的多视图交互.

blocks.en: 2.2 Text-driven 3D Editing
blocks.zh: 2.2 文本驱动的三维编辑

blocks.en: Due to the scarcity of large-scale paired 3D editing data, most text-driven 3D editing methods transfer the priors of pretrained 2D diffusion models to 3D. Related 3D generation methods, such as DreamFusion Poole et al. (2022) and ConsistentDreamer Şahin et al. (2025) , synthesize new 3D content from text or a single image. Although they do not edit existing reconstructions, they demonstrate the effectiveness of diffusion guidance for 3D optimization. For editing existing scenes, NeRF-based approaches either optimize the underlying representation using score distillation or related diffusion objectives, as in Instruct 3D-to-3D Kamata et al. (2023) , DreamEditor Zhuang et al. (2023) , and Progressive3D Cheng et al. (2023) , or follow a render-edit-optimize pipeline, as exemplified by Instruct-NeRF2NeRF Haque et al. (2023) and related follow-ups Liu et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2023) . These methods establish the feasibility of transferring 2D editing priors to 3D, but NeRF optimization is often slow, while independently edited views may provide inconsistent supervision.
blocks.zh: 由于大规模配对的3D编辑数据很少,大多数文本驱动的3D编辑方法将预先训练的2D传播模型的前身转移到3D. 相关的3D生成方法,如DreamFusion Poole等人(2022年)和ConferenceDreamer Şahin等人(2025年),从文本或单一图像合成新的3D内容. 虽然它们不编辑现有的重建,但它们展示了3D优化的传播指导的有效性. 在编辑现有场景时,基于NERF的方法要么利用分数蒸馏或相关传播目标优化基本表述,如Instruct 3D-to-3D Kamata等人(2023),DreamEditor。 Zhuang等人(2023年)和进步3D Cheng等人(2023年),或跟随渲染优化的管道,例如Instruct-NERF2NERF Haque等人(2023年)和相关的后续Liu等人(2024年);Wang等人(2022年);Wang等人(2023年)。 这些方法确立了将2D编辑前身转移到3D的可行性,但NERF优化往往很慢,而独立编辑的视图可能提供不一致的监督.

blocks.en: With the emergence of 3DGS, text-driven 3D editing methods increasingly adopt explicit Gaussian representations for more efficient rendering and optimization. GaussianEditor Wang et al. (2024) improves editing efficiency and controllability by leveraging the explicit structure of Gaussians. More recent methods, including GaussCtrl Wu et al. (2024) , DGE Chen et al. (2024) , EditSplat Lee et al. (2025) , and D 2 Gaussian Sheng et al. (2025) , further improve multi-view consistency or editing control through depth conditioning and latent alignment, epipolar-guided feature propagation, multi-view fusion, and discretized view modeling, respectively. These methods primarily improve how editing information is aligned or propagated across views. View Matters instead explicitly estimates which views provide reliable evidence for the requested edit and preserves this view-reliability hierarchy throughout both multi-view editing and 3D optimization.
blocks.zh: 随着3DGS的出现,文本驱动的3D编辑方法越来越多地采用明确的高斯表达法,以提高渲染和优化的效率. 高斯编辑器 王等编. (2024)通过利用高斯人的明确结构,提高编辑效率和可控性. 较新的方法,包括GaussCtrl Wu等人(2024年),DGE Chen et al. (2024), EditSplate Lee et al. (2025),以及 D 2 Gaussian Sheng et al. (2025),通过深度调节和潜伏对齐,上极导特性传播,多视聚变,以及盘式视模分别进一步提高多视一致性或编辑控制. 这些方法主要改进了编辑信息如何相互配合或传播。 查看事项则明确估计哪些视图为请求的编辑提供了可靠的证据,并在整个多视图编辑和3D优化过程中保持这种视图可靠性等级。

blocks.en: 2.3 View Selection and Multi-View Interaction
blocks.zh: 2.3 查看选择和多视频交互

blocks.en: View selection has been used to reduce redundancy and improve multi-view reconstruction Hornung et al. (2008) . Neural rendering methods quantify useful observations through uncertainty reduction, Fisher information, or reconstruction-aware criteria Pan et al. (2022) ; Jiang et al. (2024) ; Xiao et al. (2024) . Their objective is to acquire or retain views that best reconstruct a scene. Text-driven editing poses a different question: a useful view must expose scene geometry and carry distinctive content and evidence relevant to a language instruction.
blocks.zh: 视图选择被用于减少冗余和改进多视图重建Hornung等人(2008年). 神经渲染方法通过减少不确定性,费舍尔信息,或重建意识标准Pan等人(2022年);Jiang等人(2024年);Xiao等人(2024年)量化有用的观测结果. 他们的目标是获取或保留最佳重建场景的观点。 文本驱动的编辑提出了另一个问题:有用的观点必须暴露场景几何,并携带与语言指令相关的独特内容和证据。

blocks.en: Multi-frame diffusion methods commonly reuse attention features from reference frames to stabilize generated content Ceylan et al. (2023) . We adopt this mechanism but organize the interaction asymmetrically: a small set of keyframes interacts globally and then guides non-keyframes together with local context. This one-way guidance prevents less informative views from weakening reliable keyframe signals.
blocks.zh: 多帧扩散方法通常具有从参考框架到稳定生成内容Ceylan等人(2023年)的再利用关注特征。 我们采用这一机制,但以不对称的方式组织互动:一小组关键框架在全球范围内相互作用,然后结合当地情况指导非关键框架。 这种单向指导防止信息较少的观点削弱可靠的关键框架信号。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of View Matters. Given a 3DGS scene and an editing instruction, KIE estimates view reliability and selects representative keyframes. KGE lets these keyframes establish a shared context and asymmetrically guide less-reliable non-keyframes without reverse interference. IAO then preserves the reliability hierarchy by assigning stronger supervision to keyframes during 3DGS optimization. The resulting scene follows the requested edit faithfully while maintaining cross-view coherence.
blocks.zh: 图1:视图事项概览。 鉴于一个3DGS场景和一个编辑指令,KIE估计查看可靠性并选择具有代表性的密钥框. KGE让这些键框建立共同的上下文和不对称的引导,不发生反向干扰的不可靠的非键框. 然后,IAO通过在3DGS优化期间对密钥框架进行更强的监督,来维护可靠性等级. 由此产生的场景在保持交叉视图一致性的同时忠实地遵循请求的编辑.

blocks.en: 3.2 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 概览

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , given a 3D Gaussian scene and a text prompt, our goal is to produce an edited 3D scene that is both semantically faithful to the instruction and consistent across views. Instead of treating all rendered views equally, we perform the editing process under the guidance of a small set of representative keyframes. Our framework consists of three stages: 1) Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) , designed to score rendered views and determine representative keyframes; 2) Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) , developed to propagate editing signals from reliability-selected keyframes to non-keyframes through directed attention; and 3) Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) , introduced to prioritize representative keyframes via loss reweighting while retaining the original reconstruction objective.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,鉴于一个3D高斯的场景和文本提示,我们的目标是制作一个经过编辑的3D场景,既要精诚地忠实于指令,又要在各种观点之间保持一致. 我们不是平等地对待所有提出的意见,而是在一小组具有代表性的关键框架的指导下进行编辑工作。 我们的框架包括三个阶段: 1) Keyframe重要性估计(KIE),旨在评分观点和确定代表性的关键框架;2) Keyframe-Guided Edition(KGE),旨在通过直接关注传播从可靠性选定的关键框架到非关键框架的编辑信号;3) 重要性-意识优化(IAO),旨在通过损失重新加权确定代表性关键框架的优先次序,同时保留原来的重建目标.

blocks.en: 3.3 Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE)
blocks.zh: 3.3 关键框架重要性估计(KIE)

blocks.en: Keyframes serve as the main source of editing guidance, a natural question is which rendered views should be selected as keyframes. We address this question by estimating view importance from three complementary perspectives: geometric visibility, semantic distinctiveness Radford et al. (2021) , and edit relevance Fu et al. (2023) . The normalized scores are then fused into a final importance score, based on which representative keyframes are selected.
blocks.zh: 关键框架是编辑指导的主要来源,一个自然的问题就是,应选择提供意见作为关键框架。 我们通过从三个互补角度估计重要性来解决这一问题:几何可见度、语义特征Radford等人(2021年)和编辑相关性Fu等人(2023年)。 归一分的分数然后并入最后重要分数,据此选择具有代表性的关键框架。

blocks.en: Given the selected keyframes, we perform multi-view editing by modifying the attention computation in a pretrained IP2P model. We do not introduce additional trainable parameters. blocks.en: 3.5 Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO)
blocks.zh: 3.5 重视优化(IAO)

blocks.en: KIE identifies reliable keyframes, and KGE uses them to guide the remaining views. However, treating all edited views equally during 3DGS optimization would discard this reliability ordering and allow less reliable edits to weaken keyframe supervision. We therefore introduce IAO to preserve keyframe priority throughout scene optimization.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we first introduce the experimental setup and compare our method with representative approaches. We then directly examine how keyframe selection affects editing quality, analyze the contributions and sensitivity of the proposed components, and finally verify that the fidelity-oriented design preserves cross-view coherence.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先介绍试验设置,并将我们的方法与代表性方法进行比较。 然后,我们直接审查关键框架的选择如何影响编辑质量,分析拟议组成部分的贡献和敏感性,最后核实以忠诚为导向的设计保持了交叉视野的一致性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Datasets and Metrics.
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 数据集和计量。

blocks.en: Following prior works, we select subsets from Mip-NeRF 360 Barron et al. (2022) and IN2N Haque et al. (2023) for editing evaluation. We adopt CLIP text-image similarity (T-I) Radford et al. (2021) and CLIP directional similarity (Direction) Gal et al. (2022) to measure the alignment between edited results and text instructions. In addition, we use adjacent-view CLIP temporal scores Haque et al. (2023) to evaluate cross-view consistency, which is largely overlooked in previous methods. The evaluation contains 23 unique scene-prompt pairs covering object identity and appearance, material transformation, global environment and style, and localized editing.
blocks.zh: 继先前的作品之后,我们从Mip-NERF 360 Barron等人(2022年)和IN2N Haque等人(2023年)中选择子集进行编辑评价. 我们采用CLIP文本图像相似性(T-I) Radford 等人(2021)和CLIP方向相似性(Direction) Gal 等人(2022)来衡量编辑结果与文本指令的一致. 此外,我们使用相邻的CLIP时间分数Haque et al. (2023)来评价交叉视图的一致性,这在之前的方法中基本上被忽视了. 该评价包含23个独特的场景即时配对,涵盖对象身份和外观,材料转化,全球环境和风格,以及局部编辑.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Baselines.

We compare our method with representative NeRF-based approaches, including IN2N Haque et al. (2023) and VICA Dong and Wang (2023) , as well as representative 3DGS-based approaches, including GaussianEditor Wang et al. (2024) , GaussCtrl Wu et al. (2024) , DGE Chen et al. (2024) , and EditSplat Lee et al. (2025) . These 3DGS baselines cover iterative dataset updating, depth- and attention-based alignment, epipolar-constrained key-view propagation, and multi-view fusion, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们把我们的方法与基于NERF的代表性方法,包括IN2N Haque等人(2023年)、VICA Dong和Wang(2023年),以及基于Gaussian Editor Wang等人(2024年)、GaussCtrl Wu等人(2024年)、DGE的代表性3DGS方法进行比较。 Chen et al. (2024), 和 EditSplate Lee et al. (2025). 这些3DGS基线分别涵盖迭代数据集更新、基于深度和关注的对齐、极地受限的密钥视图传播和多视图聚合。

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Implementation Details.
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 执行细节。

blocks.en: Our method is implemented in PyTorch and can be optimized on a single 48G RTX 4090 GPU. For both NeRF-based and 3DGS-based baselines, the initial 3D representations are reconstructed from the same multi-view images under identical training settings. For fair comparison, all methods use the same input scenes, text prompts, and initialization whenever applicable. Additional details on hyperparameters, scene selection, and prompts are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.zh: 4.2 定量分析

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that View Matters achieves the best average T-I (0.2822) and Direction (0.2564) among the evaluated methods. The directional score improves by 0.0337 over GaussianEditor and 0.0412 over EditSplat, indicating more accurate instruction-following changes. Our method also completes editing in four minutes, faster than the evaluated baselines. These results show the overall benefit of organizing editing around reliable views.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,在所评价的方法中,View Matters达到最佳平均T-I(0.2822)和方向(0.2564)。 方向分数比高斯编辑器提高了0.0337分,比EditSplat提高了0.0412分,表明更准确的指令跟随变化. 我们的方法还在四分钟内完成编辑,比评估的基线更快. 这些结果显示,围绕可靠的观点组织编辑工作总体上有好处。

blocks.en: 4.3 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 3 presents two representative cases selected to span complementary regimes in both content type and spatial extent: localized editing of a human subject and global appearance editing of an outdoor scene. The former tests whether a method can apply the requested semantic change without unnecessarily modifying the surrounding content, whereas the latter requires the edit to propagate coherently across the scene while preserving its underlying geometry and layout.
blocks.zh: 图3列出了两个选定的具有代表性的案例,这些案例涉及内容类型和空间范围的补充制度:一个是人类主题的局部编辑,另一个是室外场景的全球外观编辑。 前者测试一种方法是否可以在不不必要地修改周围内容的情况下应用所请求的语义变化,而后者则要求编辑在保持其基本几何和布局的同时在全场一致传播.

blocks.en: In these examples, IN2N distorts the source content, GaussianEditor modifies editing-irrelevant regions, and GaussCtrl only partially realizes the requested semantics. In contrast, our method handles both regimes by localizing the subject-level edit and coherently propagating the scene-level transformation, achieving a better balance between instruction fidelity and content preservation. Additional comparisons are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 在这些例子中,IN2N扭曲了源内容,高斯编辑器修改了编辑相关的区域,高斯Ctrl只部分实现了所要求的语义. 相反,我们的方法处理两种制度,将主题层面的编辑本地化,并连贯地宣传场景层面的转变,在指导忠诚度和内容保存之间实现更好的平衡。 附录C提供了其他比较。

blocks.en: Figure 4: With the same candidate views and keyframe budget, random and importance-based selection yield different keyframes (top) and editing results (bottom). Our selection provides more reliable guidance and achieves a more faithful target transformation, highlighting the importance of view selection in multi-view editing.
blocks.zh: 图4:在候选人意见和关键框架预算相同的情况下,随机和基于重要性的选择产生不同的关键框架(顶部)和编辑结果(底部)。 我们的选择提供了更可靠的指导,实现了更忠实的目标转换,突出了在多视图编辑中选择视图的重要性.

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis of View Importance
blocks.zh: 4.4 观点重要性分析

blocks.en: To directly test our central claim that views contribute unequally to multi-view editing, we use a controlled sparse-view setting in which the effect of keyframe selection can be more clearly isolated. We compare importance-based selection with random selection while keeping the candidate views, keyframe budget, editing procedure, and 3DGS optimization identical. Thus, the only experimental variable is which views are selected as keyframes.
blocks.zh: 为了直接检验我们的中心主张,即观点对多视图编辑的贡献不平等,我们使用一个可控的稀有视图设置,在这种设定中,键框选择的效果可以更明确地被隔离. 我们比较基于重要性的选择和随机选择,同时保持候选人意见、关键框架预算、编辑程序和3DGS优化相同。 因此,唯一的实验变量是选择哪些观点作为关键框架。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows both the selected keyframes and their corresponding editing results. Random sampling may select views that provide less reliable geometric, semantic, or editability cues, thereby weakening the editing signal propagated to the remaining views. In contrast, our method identifies more informative keyframes and uses them to guide the other views, producing a more faithful target transformation while maintaining coherent appearance across viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 图4显示选定的关键框架及其相应的编辑结果。 随机采样可能选择提供不太可靠的几何,语义,或可编辑提示的视图,从而削弱向其余视图传播的编辑信号. 与此相反,我们的方法找出了更翔实的关键框架,并用它们来指导其他观点,产生更忠实的目标转变,同时保持不同观点的一致外表。

blocks.en: The results show that editing quality depends not only on how many views are used but also on which views provide the guidance. This result supports our central argument that views should not be treated equally in multi-view editing.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,编辑质量不仅取决于使用多少意见,还取决于哪些意见提供了指导。 这一结果支持我们的核心论点,即在多视图编辑中不应平等对待观点。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 偏差和敏感性分析

blocks.en: Following this controlled comparison, we progressively add KGE, KIE, and IAO to the per-view IP2P baseline. With KGE alone, the first view in each group serves as the keyframe. Table 2 shows that KGE improves performance through keyframe propagation, KIE provides more informative guidance, and IAO performs best by preserving keyframe priority during 3DGS optimization. These gains confirm their complementary roles. Qualitative ablations are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 经过这种有控制的比较,我们逐渐将KGE,KIE,和IAO加入到每个视图的IP2P基线中. 单是KGE,每一组的第一种观点就成了关键框架。 表2显示,KGE通过按键帧传播提高了性能,KIE提供了更多的信息化指导,IAO通过在3DGS优化期间保留按键帧优先性来发挥最佳性能. 这些成果证实了它们的互补作用。 附录B提供了定性说明。

blocks.en: Figure 5 analyzes the geometric visibility, semantic distinctiveness, and edit-relevance cues in KIE. Here, X X -dom assigns 0.6 to cue X X and 0.2 to the others; X X -only retains only X X ; and No- X X removes X X while equally weighting the other two cues. Removing the geometric cue causes the largest degradation in editing fidelity. This cue is derived directly from the underlying 3DGS and captures the intrinsic view-dependent observability of the scene, providing a reliable basis for identifying informative views. Accordingly, Geo-dom, with weights ( 0.6 , 0.2 , 0.2 ) (0.6,0.2,0.2) , achieves the highest TI and Direction while largely preserving adjacent-view consistency. This result supports our central design of explicitly selecting views according to their 3D editing evidence. Nevertheless, geometry alone underperforms Geo-dom: removing semantics weakens the intended edit direction, while removing edit relevance reduces semantic alignment and consistency. These results demonstrate that the three cues are complementary. We therefore adopt Geo-dom as the default setting, prioritizing 3D geometric evidence while retaining semantic and instruction-related cues for keyframe selection.

blocks.en: 4.6 Cross-View Consistency Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 跨视频一致性分析

blocks.en: Although View Matters introduces no separate consistency-specific module or loss, its reliability-guided design does not sacrifice cross-view coherence. Instead, shared keyframe guidance in KGE establishes a common editing context, while local propagation maintains continuity between adjacent views. Figure 6 presents two representative ordered-view case studies rather than an aggregate consistency benchmark. Quantitatively, our method achieves higher CLIP temporal scores in both examples, reflecting stronger consistency across rendered views. Qualitatively, this improvement is evident in the highlighted regions, where our method produces more coherent local details and more stable visual patterns across viewpoints. In contrast, GaussCtrl suffers from greater inter-view variation, leading to inconsistent local appearance and reduced structural coherence.
blocks.zh: 虽然 View Matters没有引入单独的一致性特定模块或丢失,但其可靠性引导设计并不牺牲交叉视图的一致性. 相反,KGE中共享的关键框架指南确立了共同的编辑背景,而本地传播则保持了相邻观点之间的连续性。 图6列出了两项有代表性的有序观点案例研究,而不是总体一致性基准。 从数量上看,我们的方法在两个例子中都实现了更高的CLIP时间分数,反映出所发表意见之间更加一致。 从质量上讲,这种改进在突出的区域是显而易见的,在这些区域,我们的方法产生了更一致的地方细节和更稳定的不同观点的视觉模式。 相比之下,GaussCtrl的视差较大,导致局部外观不一致,结构一致性降低.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: View Matters organizes text-driven 3D Gaussian editing around unequal view reliability. KIE identifies reliable editing anchors, KGE propagates their information asymmetrically without noisy reverse influence, and IAO preserves the same priority during 3D optimization. The resulting framework improves instruction alignment and editing efficiency among the evaluated methods, while representative adjacent-view analyses indicate that the fidelity-oriented design maintains cross-view coherence.
blocks.zh: View Matters将文本驱动的3D Gaussian编辑围绕不平等的视图可靠性组织起来. KIE识别可靠的编辑主播,KGE在无噪音反向影响的情况下不对称地传播他们的信息,IAO在3D优化期间保留同样的优先级. 由此产生的框架提高了受评价方法之间的指导协调和编辑效率,而代表性的相邻观点分析表明,以忠诚为导向的设计保持了交叉观点的一致性。

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. B.1 , increasing the number of keyframes from 2 to 4 improves both T-I and Dir, while the training time and memory consumption remain almost unchanged. This indicates that introducing a moderate number of keyframes can provide stronger supervision without noticeable additional computational overhead. When the number of keyframes is further increased to 5, the resource cost is still similar, but the performance shows a slight drop compared with the 4-view setting. Increasing the number of keyframes to 10 leads to a clear increase in both training time and GPU memory usage, while failing to bring further quantitative gains. blocks.en: B.3 Qualitative Ablation Results
blocks.zh: B.3 定性结果

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. B.3 , Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) introduces richer target textures, suppresses undesired texture changes on the clothes, and mitigates the inconsistency around the neck region. Further incorporating Keyframe Importance Estimation enhances the details of the eye-mask region and removes part of the residual original eye contour. After additionally introducing Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO), the method fully suppresses the interference of the original eye contours and better preserves the appearance of non-edited regions, yielding the most reliable and consistent editing results. This improvement indicates that only when the 3D optimization process explicitly accounts for the different importance of views can the model achieve the best editing quality, which also validates our core insight that view importance matters in 3D Gaussian editing.
blocks.zh: 如图B.3所示,Keyframe-Guided eded edition(KGE)引入了更丰富的目标纹理,抑制了衣服上不想要的纹理变化,缓解了颈部区域周围的不一致. 进一步纳入关键框架重要性估计可以增强眼罩区域的细节,并去除部分残存的原眼轮廓. 在另外引入了重要性-意识优化(IAO)后,该方法完全压制了原眼轮廓的干扰,更好地保存了非编辑区域外观,产生了最可靠和一致的编辑结果. 这一改进表明,只有当3D优化过程明确说明观点的不同重要性时,模型才能达到最佳编辑质量,这也验证了我们在3D Gaussian编辑中看待重要性事项的核心见解.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和讨论

blocks.en: Our framework has two main limitations. First, it employs a frozen 2D image editor and therefore inherits its failure modes. Edits involving substantial geometric changes or fine-grained local structures may be limited by the underlying editor. Since KGE, KIE, and IAO organize cross-view guidance and 3D supervision without retraining the editing backbone, they could potentially be adapted to stronger attention-based editors in future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架有两个主要的局限性。 首先,它使用冷冻的2D图像编辑器,因此继承了它的故障模式. 涉及重大几何变化或细纹局部结构的编辑可能受基础编辑器的限制. 由于KGE,KIE,以及IAO组织交叉视图指导和3D监督,而不重新培训编辑骨干,因此在未来的工作中它们有可能适应更强大的关注编辑.

blocks.en: Second, the benefit of view-importance modeling depends on the variation in editing reliability across candidate views. When densely sampled views provide similarly clear observations, the distinction between keyframes and other views becomes smaller, and the improvement over uniform treatment may be modest. Conversely, if none of the candidate views clearly observes the target region, view selection alone cannot provide a reliable editing anchor. Our controlled sparse-view experiments examine the former reliability differences, while more extreme visibility conditions remain an important direction for future evaluation.
blocks.zh: 第二,视图-重要性模型的优点取决于不同候选人意见编辑可靠性的变化。 当大量抽样的意见提供类似明确的意见时,关键框架与其他意见之间的区别就会缩小,而相对于统一待遇而言,改进可能不大。 相反,如果没有一个候选人的意见明确遵守目标区域,单凭选择就无法提供可靠的编辑主播。 我们所控制的零视实验审查了以前的可靠性差异,而更极端的可见度条件仍然是今后评价的一个重要方向。
